description: agentfence: check every tool call against your policy before it runs

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'agentfence: Node.js 18+ is required to enforce your policy. Install Node or disable the agentfence plugin.' >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/agentfence.mjs" hook
